sample-1727-1: I study human-computer interaction at UMaine. People consistently disclose more, and verify less, when they believe they're talking to a human. A simple disclosure requirement is the lowest-cost, highest-value AI rule a state can pass, and Maine can lead on it.
sample-1727-2: I'm 78 years old. Last month a very pleasant 'agent' spent twenty minutes convincing my neighbor about an insurance product before she realized it wasn't a person. Just make them say what they are. It's the same reason we make telemarketers identify themselves.
